payload.title: New Albany girls golf celebrates Class 4A state championship
payload.content:
New Albany's girls golf team celebrated its Class 4A state championship in a school social media post Monday, Oct. 26. The accompanying graphic identifies the team as NA Girls Golf and includes five players' comments reflecting on their teammates, work and championship, alongside photographs and a Class 4A trophy.

Source: Original school announcement and graphic

Correction (Oct. 27, 2026): An earlier version omitted New Albany's team name and incorrectly said player comments were unavailable. The original source graphic includes five player comments.
payload.excerpt: New Albany's Class 4A girls golf championship graphic includes five players' comments celebrating their team.
